about:
Becker Electronics, Inc. operates from Ronkonkoma, New York, where it has provided build-to-print contract manufacturing since 1996. The company began as a custom electronics manufacturer and has grown through a focus on customer service, quality control, and flexibility.

The shop specializes in custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, mechanical assemblies, intricate soldering, panel and box builds, multiconductor and flat-ribbon cable assemblies, and wire preparation. It runs high-speed production equipment and maintains a large inventory backed by international sourcing channels. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not publicly disclosed.

Becker serves the automated lighting, military, communication systems, audio, home automation, and solar industries. Customers include original equipment manufacturers and system integrators in those sectors, though specific client names are not published.

The company cites its devotion to customer needs, quality control, and flexibility as the drivers behind its growth. It holds AS9100:2016 certification and emphasizes a “yes” attitude toward customer requests.
